titles.native: ファンタジスタドール

description:
Uno Uzume, a girl who used to be an elite player at card tournaments, is one day given a curious device which uses special cards to summon artificially intelligent female warriors known as Fantasista Dolls. From this day on, Uzume spends each day spending time with her new friends, while also fighting battles against other card masters who seek to have their wishes granted in exchange for defeating her.

(Adapted from: Wiki)
